title: VocabEntry
description: A single vocabulary entry in the Japanese-learning knowledge base.

id.description: Unique slug identifier, e.g. 'taberu', 'ohayou'. ASCII, hyphens allowed.

kana.description: The word written entirely in hiragana (or katakana for loanwords).

kanji.description: The standard kanji+kana spelling, or null if the word is kana-only.

reading.description: Full hiragana reading, including okurigana, e.g. 'た.べる'.

transitivity.description: For verbs: 'tr' (transitive / 他動詞), 'intr' (intransitive / 自動詞), or null for non-verbs.

english.description: One or more English glosses, most common first.

drop_after_mora.description: Drop position: 0 = heiban (no drop), n > 0 = drop after mora n.

example_sentences.description: One or more example sentences. Leave empty array [] if none yet authored.

kana.description: The sentence written entirely in kana (spaces optional for readability).

kanji.description: The sentence in its normal kanji+kana orthography, or null if kana-only.

module_introduced.description: Module number (0–12) in which this word is first introduced.

frequency_rank_bccwj.description: Rank in the BCCWJ spoken-corpus frequency list (1 = most frequent), or null if unknown.

notes.description: Freeform authoring note, common mistake flag, or cross-reference. null if unused.
